cd /workspace/dev && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time
svcs = ['t%d' % i for i in range(7)] + ['a','b','c'] + ['u%d' % i for i in range(14)]
args = [{'op':'contains','path':['t%d' % i]} for i in range(7)] + \
       [{'op':'contains','path':['a']*16}, {'op':'contains','path':['b']*16},
        {'op':'contains','path':['c']*8}]
req = {'services': svcs,
       'rules': [{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':args}}],
       'queries': [['a']*4096, ['t0','a','b','c'], []]}
line = json.dumps(req).encode()
print('input bytes', len(line))
t0=time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                   input=line+b'\n', capture_output=True)
t1=time.time()
out = json.loads(p.stdout)
print('rc', p.returncode, 'wall %.2fs' % (t1-t0), 'out bytes', len(p.stdout))
if out.get('ok'):
    print('states', len(out['dfa']['accept']), 'accepting', sum(out['dfa']['accept']))
    print('queries', out['queries'])
else:
    print(out)
PYEOF
